english: My older brother is very busy today, so I am going to help him. Tomorrow afternoon I want to go swimming with a friend. Do you want to go with us?
reference: 我哥哥今天很忙，我去帮他的忙。明天下午我想和朋友去游泳，你想和我们一起去吗？
topic: Helping my brother and going swimming

issues.description: The English "so" (cause and result) has no equivalent in the reference. Chinese often leaves out 所以, so this is acceptable, but a learner who writes 所以 would be marked differently from the reference.
The reference uses 帮他的忙 (a separable verb-object phrase from 帮忙), which is above HSK 2. HSK 2 learners are more likely to write 帮助他, so the automatic grader may mark a correct answer as wrong.
"I am going to help him" is translated as 我去帮…, which sounds more like "I'm going over to help" than a plan. 我要帮他 would be closer to "am going to".
